issue_context.title: Feature: Cancel search when pressing esc key
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

Currently if you are in the middle of a search and press escape, the app treats it like enter and continues the search. This goes against the escape button's supposed behavior.

### Requirements 

Pressing escape should cancel the search.

### Priorities

| Capability | Priority |
| :---------- | :------- |
| Pressing `esc` cancels search | Must |


### Files Version

Version: 2.3.0.0 

### Windows Version

10.0.19044.1766

### Comments

_No response_
